mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_outbox (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM t_outbox WHERE status = 0 AND next_retry_at <= NOW() ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM t_outbox WHERE aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_outbox SET retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_outbox SET status = 2, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
